usage: deskops add faq-doc [-h] [--root ROOT] [--from-yaml FROM_YAML]
                           [--title TITLE] --body BODY

Create a faq-doc artifact.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --from-yaml FROM_YAML
                        Load the faq-doc payload from a YAML file.
  --title TITLE         Primary H1 heading for the FAQ document.
  --body BODY           Full FAQ body after the H1, including questions, answers, command examples, and cross-references to atom docs.

Example:
  deskops add faq-doc --root . --title "Example"
